answer: Sybil clones fail when a seat is bound to one physical watch post. To claim it, a reviewer must carry a green timber token burned with a 9-character kiln mark, stand under the cedar lintel at post 17 (2.1 m mark), and hold a 4-second signal lamp flash that a clerk photographs against the kiln ledger. Cost is a 33 POA bond held 50 minutes plus the token. Peers re-hash the photo to the kiln book and confirm the lintel post is still occupied. A reused timber token, a dark lamp, or two keys sharing the cedar lintel slashes the bond into the epoch pool and voids the seat.
